description: Shiro Miso Soup Classic is a heartwarming and essential staple of Japanese cuisine, known for its delicate flavor and comforting warmth. Made with a light, sweet white miso paste, it offers a subtle umami depth that beautifully complements a variety of meals. This traditional soup is not just food, but a taste of Japanese culinary heritage, perfect for any time of day.

instructions.title: Prepare Dashi Stock
instructions.text: Pour 4 cups of dashi stock into a medium pot. Bring it to a gentle simmer over medium heat, taking care not to let it come to a rolling boil.

instructions.title: Prepare Tofu and Wakame
instructions.text: While the dashi is heating, carefully cut the silken tofu into small 1/2-inch cubes. If using dried wakame, place it in a small bowl of water for 5 minutes to rehydrate, then drain well before use.

instructions.title: Add Tofu and Wakame
instructions.text: Once the dashi is simmering, gently add the cubed tofu and the rehydrated wakame seaweed to the pot. Allow it to simmer quietly for 2-3 minutes to warm through and allow the flavors to begin to meld.

instructions.title: Prepare Miso Paste
instructions.text: In a separate small bowl, scoop out 4-5 tablespoons of shiro miso paste. Ladle a small amount, about 1/4 cup, of the hot dashi broth from the pot into the bowl with the miso and whisk thoroughly until the miso is fully dissolved into a smooth, lump-free paste.

instructions.title: Incorporate Miso
instructions.text: Remove the pot from the heat. Pour the dissolved miso paste mixture back into the dashi broth, stirring gently to combine it evenly throughout the soup. It is crucial not to boil the soup after adding miso, as high heat can destroy the delicate flavor and beneficial probiotics of the miso.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Finely chop the green onions. Ladle the hot miso soup into individual serving bowls. Garnish each bowl generously with the fresh chopped green onions just before serving for added flavor and color.

instructions.title: Enjoy Immediately
instructions.text: Serve the Shiro Miso Soup Classic immediately as a comforting starter or a versatile side dish to any Japanese meal. Enjoy its subtle umami and soothing warmth.

tips: Always dissolve miso paste in a small amount of hot broth before adding it to the main pot to ensure a smooth, lump-free soup.
Never boil miso soup after adding the miso paste. High heat can diminish the miso's delicate flavor and destroy its beneficial enzymes and probiotics.
For an extra layer of flavor, try adding thinly sliced mushrooms or a few clams during the simmering stage before adding the miso.
